versions.changelog:
No user-facing changes in this version.  
- No file changes detected; functionality and documentation remain unchanged.

Initial release introducing the "compose-methods" skill for structured content creation:

- Provides two universal paradigms: "清单法" (Checklist Method) and "样本法" (Sample Method) for generating any type of structured output.
- Guides users to select either method—or a combination—when requesting documents, plans, reports, presentations, codes, etc.
- Outlines clear workflows for both methods, including identifying goals, sourcing/checking lists or samples, content assembly, and user review.
- Details search and validation strategies for acquiring templates and samples when needed.
- Clarifies that this skill is a methodological guide, not a replacement for domain-specific skills or output formatting tools.
